name: steward
description: Separate intent and assurance from software construction with portable, approved Markdown contracts. Frame turns a problem into a self-contained ticket, critique independently challenges the proposal, and assess judges completed changes claim by claim against the frozen revision.

interface.longDescription: Create self-contained Markdown tickets, independently critique them, freeze an explicitly approved revision, and assess completed software changes claim by claim using observable evidence. Steward keeps intent and assurance separate from the interchangeable builder and requires no remote service or builder adapter.
defaultPrompt: Frame this request as an approvable contract.
Assess this change against its frozen contract.
